item.title: Regular aerobic exercise linked to younger brain, study shows
item.description: A year-long program of regular aerobic exercise can result in a biologically "younger" brain, according to new research linking physical activity with long-term brain health.

item.title: Snowy conditions lead to ‘dozens’ of crashes on Indiana Toll Road
item.description: "Dozens" of crashes happened Jan. 19, 2026, on the Indiana Toll Road near South Bend due to snowy and windy conditions, resulting in injuries and delays, state police say.

item.title: Taking a holy drop of Bloomington to the National Championship Game in Miami
item.description: Photographer Garrett Ewald has been sprinkling holy water from Bloomington on the Hoosiers' end zones this postseason, in hopes of bringing a drop of Bloomington to the College Football Playoff National Championship Game in Miami.

item.title: Fishers PD: 17-year-old runaway now considered ‘endangered’
item.description: Fishers Police Department is searching for 17-year-old Hailey Buzbee, who ran away from her home on January 5th and is now considered an "endangered missing juvenile".

item.title: Indiana hemp drug ban clears first hurdle
item.description: Indiana lawmakers are seeking to align state law with a federal ban on intoxicating and synthetic hemp products, over opposition from the delta-8 industry, with a proposed bill that would regulate less potent products and implement a 21-plus age requirement.

item.title: IU football coach Cignetti accomplishes what few imagined could be done
item.description: Curt Cignetti came to Indiana to win championships. The old-school, blunt-spoken coach who began his Hoosiers tenure with a promise to bring swift success to the losingest program in college football completed his masterpiece on Monday night. Cignetti guided Indiana to a 27-21 win over the Miami Hurricanes in the College Football Playoff final and the first national championship in school history.
